background: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: background plate for a premium realtime desktop wallpaper, cinematic landscape, wide 16:9. Create an exceptionally beautiful natural photograph of a quiet northern Russian lake after summer rain at golden hour. Authentic small timber houses on the distant LEFT shoreline, modest countryside architecture, dark birch and pine woodland framing the distant bank, broad open mirrorlike lake occupying the lower half, rich subtle reflections of amber sky in cool blue teal water. A small bright gap in clouds near upper right horizon, luminous but controlled warm light, layered pearly storm clouds and lingering pale mist over distant treeline. Composition: horizon at about 45% height, foreground lake clear and unobstructed so animated reeds and branches can be composited later; no close foreground branches, no reeds or large objects across the frame; no people. Mood calm, expensive fine-art landscape photography, believable fine natural texture, no oversaturated neon colors, no exaggerated HDR, no painting look, no cartoon, no text, no symbols, no watermark, no logo. Image must hold up full screen: precise cabin timber, realistic distant trees, delicate cloud structure, clean natural reflections. Request native 3840x2160 landscape resolution if supported. Keep important subjects comfortably inside the frame.

Avoid fake plastic leaves, repeated identical leaf shapes or a heavy dense canopy.
